rules: both device classes now use the Node per-call solver limit (NODE_SOLVER_MS 3000), so a clock-stopped solver call skips the world as in Node; the shorter-than-Node discard rule stays only for a future shorter budget
solver table sizes unchanged: within one call the table grows by at most solverMaxNodes (1.5M), so the memory bound does not depend on the time limits
first-load wait decoupled from the search budget (FIRST_LOAD_WAIT_MS 10000)

the move coach uses the same budgets; a new coach request asks the previous turn's running coach search to stop (no worker replacement); table searches still preempt the coach and the coach never blocks the human's move

human timeout autoplay still plays 017 without searching; computer seats are not timed while the host waits for the search after the 0.5-1 s think delay; a joiner's countdown for that seat can reach 0 only if a first load finishes just inside 10 s and the following search then runs to the 56 s hard timeout, and then it only waits for the host's event
